articles.summary: What if the biggest bottleneck in your AI roadmap isn't talent, budget, or technology, but the gap between what your technical teams can build and what they can safely deploy?
articles.title: Your Teams Need AI Governance Skills. Here's How to Build Them

articles.summary: I’m excited to share Coursera’s first AI in Higher Education Report, exploring AI use and attitudes among students and educators globally. The report found that nearly all students and educators are now using AI to facilitate personalized learning, provide real-time feedback, and increase productivity and efficiency.
articles.title: New Coursera report shows that 95% of students and educators are using AI on campus — but only a quarter of educators worldwide feel prepared to use it effectively
